summary: E2E verification of the two new features: (1) GET /api/listings/{id}/similar and (2) POST /api/search/vibe, plus their frontend integrations. Backend pytest suite (4/4) passes: /similar returns <=12 items, excludes source, all items share source category, 404 for unknown id; /vibe rejects <2 char body with 400, and /vibe 'cozy minimalist home' returns full payload (explanation, keywords, categories[id/name/slug], brand_hints, price_range, fallback, items, total) with non-empty items via graceful fallback. Frontend Playwright flow (single run, 100% pass): ListingDetail /listing/{id} renders 'You may also like' (data-testid=similar-items-section) with 12 cards, left/right scroll buttons work, and the existing 'Complete the look' bundle section is still present below (regression OK). Search page shows the 'Vibe search on AI' toggle (data-testid=vibe-mode-toggle); clicking it reveals the vibe panel with input, submit button, and all 6 example chips (vibe-example-*). Clicking a chip triggers loading state (~3–5s), then renders vibe-results including vibe-explanation ('Cozy, simple home decor with soft textures and clean lines.'), category tags (Home), keyword chips (ceramic vase, linen pillow, throw blanket, table lamp), brand hint chips (IKEA, West Elm, CB2, MUJI), a 'broadened' fallback badge, and a vibe-items-grid with 24 product cards. Clear button (vibe-clear) resets the panel and the example chips reappear (results dismissed). Custom text vibe ('streetwear') submitted via the form also produces valid vibe-results.
critical_code_review_comments: search.py /listings/{id}/similar: fallback query includes 'id' both in q_base ($ne) and $nin; harmless duplication but $ne is already sufficient — small cleanup opportunity.

VibeSearch.jsx: request timeout inherited from api client — LLM calls can occasionally exceed default axios timeout on cold starts; consider passing an explicit longer timeout (e.g., 30s) so the loading state doesn't fail silently.
SimilarItems.jsx: hides entire section when API returns empty array (good). However, no error surfaced when API 500s — user sees nothing. Consider a subtle inline error state for observability.

search_vibe endpoint depends on Emergent LLM key at request time; if the key is missing/rate-limited the endpoint will bubble up a raw exception. A guarded 503 fallback with an empty-but-structured payload would be more resilient.
Regression: legacy iteration_13 issues (Header ribbon slice(0,14), missing 3 quick-link chips in CategoryMegaMenu) were not part of this scope and were not re-verified in this run.
test_credentials: Not required — /similar and /vibe are public endpoints.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new endpoints and their UI hooks are green. Vibe LLM call reliably returned in ~3-4s during testing and used the 'broadened' fallback for 'cozy minimalist home' (categories=[Home], items=24). If retesting, the pytest module /app/backend/tests/test_similar_and_vibe.py covers the API contract; the Playwright script exercised chip click, custom submit, clear, and regression of 'Complete the look'. Screenshots: /app/test_reports/similar.png, /app/test_reports/vibe_results.png.
